title: EventRoutingRequestedV1
description: Kernel-internal routing intent: a Work needs an assignment for a capability. Emitted by every Work-creating arm (REST ingress and provider ingest); consumed by the kernel routing funnel, which resolves candidates, chooses one, and writes the work.assign row as the routing effect. Never leaves the kernel.

team.description: Soft team context (slug). Omitted when the work carries no team; the funnel then routes team-agnostically. Cross-team exclusion always applies against the work's owning team.

effectKey.description: Effect-identity override: the assign effect row is '<commandIdBase>:<effectKey>' instead of '<commandIdBase>:<workId>'. A re-dispatch intent uses the steer command id, preserving the envelope read-back command-id ledger (work-redispatch:<steerId>) across the routing cutover.

targetId.description: Envelope targetId resolved by the caller (rule target, provider default); rides verbatim into the assign effect.

preferenceEndpointId.description: Caller's preferred endpoint (e.g. a provider config's fixed AssignEndpointId). Honored only when the endpoint is an allowed candidate; otherwise the deterministic order decides and the audit records the fallback.

commandIdBase.description: Base of the chosen assignment's command id: the effect row is '<base>:<effectKey>' (effectKey defaults to the workId), keeping routing replay-idempotent.

referenceJson.description: JSON array serialized to inputs.sourceRefs of the assign effect (provider re-hydration lineage).

extraInputsJson.description: Rule-configured extra inputs (JSON object) merged into the assign's inputs.extras.
